answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the ripple of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on strict entropy generation requirements tied to verifiable physical clock intervals. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short. The violet holds work receipts rather than names, so the pearl of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
